title: Linux/Windows privesc triage (post-access, authorized)
description: Local enumeration checklist after gaining a foothold.
detail: Only with explicit authorization on compromised-in-scope hosts. Linux: id/sudo -l, SUID/SGID, cron/systemd timers, writable paths/services, kernel/version, creds in files/env, containers. Windows: whoami /priv, services/unquoted paths, scheduled tasks, AlwaysInstallElevated, stored creds, token/impersonation context. Map to post-exploitation/privilege-escalation skills; capture evidence; avoid persistence unless in scope.
